description_en: Creates a consumer group for ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ. A consumer group is a load balancing group that contains multiple consumers with the same consumption behavior. Consumers must specify a consumer group and the relevant topics to subscribe to messages
description_zh: 创建云消息队列 RocketMQ 版的消费者分组（ConsumerGroup）。消费者分组是云消息队列 RocketMQ 版系统中承载多个消费行为一致的消费者的负载均衡分组。消费者需要通过指定消费者分组订阅相关的主题来实现消息订阅
kebab_example: aliyun rocketmq create-consumer-group --instance-id rmq-cn-7e22ody0000 --consumer-group-id GID_test_groupId --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateConsumerGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the consumer group belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待创建的消费者分组所属的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the consumer group that you want to create. This ID is used to identify the consumer group and must be globally unique.

The value must meet the following requirements:

The ID can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

The ID must be 1 to 60 characters in length.

For more information about reserved characters, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440347.html
parameters.help_zh:
待创建的消费者分组的ID。用于标识消费者分组，全局唯一。

取值说明如下：

字符限制：支持字母a\~z或A\~Z、数字0\~9以及下划线（_）、短划线（-）。
长度限制：1~60个字符。

保留字符限制，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440347.html
parameters.name: consumer_group_id

fields.help_en:
The dead-letter topic.

If a consumer fails to consume a message after the maximum number of retries, the message is delivered to a dead-letter topic. You can then perform business recovery or backtrace the message. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440356.html
fields.help_zh:
死信Topic。

消费者出现异常消费某条消息失败，且消息重试后依然未成功，消息将被投递至死信Topic中，以便后续进行业务恢复或回溯。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440356.html
fields.name: dead_letter_target_topic

fields.help_en:
The fixed retry interval. Unit: seconds. This parameter is valid only if you set the retry policy to FixedRetryPolicy.
Valid values:

Concurrent delivery: 10 to 1800

Orderly delivery: 1 to 600
fields.help_zh:
固定重试间隔，单位：秒。重试策略为FixedRetryPolicy固定间隔重试策略时生效
取值范围：
并发投递：10-1800
顺序投递：1-600
fields.name: fixed_interval_retry_time

fields.help_en:
The type of the retry policy. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440356.html.

Valid values:

FixedRetryPolicy: retries at a fixed interval. This policy is available only for orderly message delivery.

DefaultRetryPolicy: retries with a backoff. This policy is available only for concurrent message delivery
fields.help_zh:
重试策略类型。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440356.html。

参数取值如下：
FixedRetryPolicy：固定间隔重试，仅支持顺序投递
DefaultRetryPolicy：阶梯退避重试，仅支持并发投递
fields.name: retry_policy

parameters.help_en:
The retry policy for the consumer group. For more information, see
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440356.html
parameters.help_zh:
待创建消费者分组的消费重试策略。更多信息，请参见
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440356.html
parameters.name: consume_retry_policy

parameters.help_en:
The delivery order of the consumer group.

Valid values:

Concurrently: Messages are delivered concurrently.

Orderly: Messages are delivered in order
parameters.help_zh:
待创建消费者分组的投递顺序性。

参数取值如下：
Concurrently：并发投递
Orderly：顺序投递
parameters.name: delivery_order_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum TPS for message consumption
parameters.name: max_receive_tps

parameters.help_en:
The consumption mode. Valid values:

CLUSTERING

LITE_SELECTIVE
parameters.help_zh:
消费者对消息的消费模式：
CLUSTERING
LITE_SELECTIVE
parameters.name: message_model

parameters.example: This is the remark for test.
parameters.help_en: The remarks on the consumer group
parameters.help_zh: 待创建消费者分组的备注信息
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The name of the lite topic that the consumer group subscribes to. This parameter is required if you set messageModel to LITE_SELECTIVE
parameters.help_zh: LITE_SELECTIVE 消费模式时，需要订阅的lite类型的topic名称
parameters.name: topic_name

requestId.description_en: The request ID. Each request has a unique ID. You can use this ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求ID，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
